title: ColumnMenu
summary: A Columns menu with one checkable item per column, to show and hide the columns of a table: a MonarchButton that opens a MonarchMenu with a checkbox in each item.
whenToUse: Above a table or data grid whose columns people may hide, such as a list of contacts with optional email, plan and created columns.
whenNotToUse: To filter which rows are shown, use filter chips. To reorder columns, use a reorderable list in a settings sheet. To switch between whole layouts, use a view switcher.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMenu(expanded: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, offset: DpOffset = DpOffset(MonarchTokens.Space.space0.dp, MonarchTokens.Space.space1.dp), content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchMenuItem(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, destructive: Boolean = false, selected: Boolean? = null, shortcut: String? = null, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchCheckbox(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, …)

states.name: shown
states.description: The item's Checkbox is checked and the item's toggleable state is on.

states.name: last column
states.description: The last visible column's item is disabled, so the table is never empty (the web's minVisible of 1).

states.name: all shown
states.description: Show all columns is disabled when every column is visible.

appearance: The Material 3 menu in the raised background role with Monarch's medium radius; the trigger is a small secondary MonarchButton and each item ends with a MonarchCheckbox in the accent colors Monarch maps to the scheme. The same mapping in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ColumnMenu is a component that takes DataTable's column state and offers minVisible, showAll, onReset and a trigger size. On Android the same result is a few lines of a MonarchMenu with a MonarchCheckbox in each item, so Monarch adds no type: minVisible is enabled = false on the last visible item, Show all and Reset are items after a MonarchDivider, and the trigger size is the MonarchButton size. The web keeps the menu open while items are checked; on Android the item's onClick changes the set and leaves expanded as it is. iOS documents the same menu as a native SwiftUI Menu with Toggles.
accessibility: The trigger is a button; its state description says how many columns are shown ("3 of 4 shown"), like the web's hidden count.
Each column item carries a toggleable state with the checkbox role, so TalkBack says checked or not checked; the MonarchCheckbox inside has a null callback so the item is the one target.
A disabled last column is announced as disabled, so TalkBack users know it cannot be hidden.
Material 3 gives each item a row at least 48dp high.
edgeCases: Keep at least one column visible by disabling the last visible item.
The menu stays open while columns are toggled; close it from Show all or by tapping outside.
Keep the visible set in the view model or rememberSaveable (as a list of ids) so it survives a configuration change.
